subject: Re: Renewal — capacity increase, PO submission, and billing recipient change
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@oriongrid.com>, procurement@oriongrid.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity increase — next steps for invoicing and PO

Hi Tom / Orion procurement team,

Thanks for the conversation yesterday — excited to move forward on the renewal and the additional 2 GPU nodes we discussed (projected go-live July 15). To get procurement and billing set up cleanly we need: 1) a PO referencing the renewal deal (so we can apply the committed capacity on our side), 2) the billing recipient (email) and legal entity name for invoicing, and 3) a W-9 (or W-8 if applicable) and EIN so Finance can validate the account.

If you can attach the PO and confirm the billing email we will: 1) prepare an amendment reflecting the +2 nodes and the unchanged SKUs, 2) issue an initial pro-forma invoice to the collector you specify, and 3) start the Net45 credit check if you request extended terms.

Let me know if your preferred invoice recipient should be the procurement mailbox or a centralized billing-ops inbox. Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
Attachment: (none)

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@oriongrid.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@oriongrid.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:30:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — next steps for invoicing and PO

Hi Olga,

Thanks — attaching the PO now. PO #789012 covers the renewal term through 2028 and the two extra nodes (line items included). Please send the amended contract and invoice to: billing-ops@oriongrid.com.

Also: we'd like to move to Net45 for this renewal (we can confirm internal approvals) — can Redwood handle Net45 for this account? If Net45 is acceptable we'll proceed to attach the W-9 and sign the amendment.

I've attached the PO and our procurement contact is on CC.

Tom
Tom Alvarez
Head of Procurement, OrionGrid
Attachment: OrionGrid_PO_789012.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@oriongrid.com>, procurement@oriongrid.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 12:05:43 -0700
Subject: Fwd: PO #789012 — billing collector change & Net45 request

Forwarding PO from OrionGrid. Key asks from the customer: billing to billing-ops@oriongrid.com, PO #789012 attached, and a request to move to Net45. Capacity increase effective target: July 15.

Ben — can Finance run the Net45 credit review and confirm whether we can accept Net45 for this renewal? Also confirm whether we should issue the first invoice now or wait until the amendment is fully signed.

Marissa — can you confirm the fleet activation date (I flagged July 15) and whether we need a canary window? We'll need these dates for the amendment.

Quoting Tom below.

--Olga

> On Tue, 29 Jun 2027 at 11:30, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@oriongrid.com> wrote:
> > Please see attached PO #789012. Invoice to billing-ops@oriongrid.com.
> > Would like Net45 if possible.
> > Attachment: OrionGrid_PO_789012.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:20:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: PO #789012 — billing collector change & Net45 request

Thanks for the ping. A couple items from Finance:

- We can consider Net45 but we'll need the signed W-9 (EIN) and the completed credit application to run the credit check. Once the credit check clears, we can set Net45 for the account and issue invoices on that cadence.
- For the immediate renewal invoice: we can generate the invoice to billing-ops@oriongrid.com now (pro-forma) and mark it Pending until the amendment is fully signed; if terms change after signature we'll issue an adjusted invoice.
- Please have the customer attach: W-9 (PDF) and the completed CreditApp (attached on our side if you want to pre-fill).

Attaching a blank CreditApp in case Orion prefers Redwood's form.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: CreditApp_OrionGrid.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@oriongrid.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 14:10:05 -0700
Subject: Signed amendment and W-9 (PO #789012)

Hi all,

Attached: Signed amendment (adds +2 nodes, keeps same SKUs), and W-9 with EIN. We confirm billing-ops@oriongrid.com as the invoice recipient and agree to Net45. Activation window still July 15.

Please confirm once you have the signed docs and the amendment is executed on Redwood's side.

Tom
Attachment: Signed_Amendment_OrionGrid_2027.pdf (application/pdf); OrionGrid_W9.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@oriongrid.com>, billing-ops@oriongrid.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmation: Amendment executed and invoice posted (PO #789012)

Tom / billing team — thanks, I have everything we need. Summary of next steps we completed just now:

- Amendment executed in DocuSign and counter-signed by Redwood. DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.net/envelope/ABC123DEF
- Invoice generated and posted to your collector (billing-ops@oriongrid.com): https://redwood-invoices.example.com/2027/ORION-789012 (you should see the invoice PDF attached to that link).
- Finance (Ben) will run the credit check for Net45 and confirm the terms in 1 business day.
- Capacity activation scheduled for July 15; Marissa will confirm the playbook for the canary rollout tomorrow.

If anything looks off on the invoice line items or legal entity name please flag immediately and we'll issue an adjusted invoice.

Thanks for the smooth turnaround — looking forward to the expansion.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
